style: Style: classic MU Online (Webzen) fantasy MMORPG interface - dark burnished bronze and antique gold filigree metal, deep red gemstones, gothic angular shapes, rich painterly game-UI rendering, crisp clean edges, orthographic flat front view, no text, no letters, no watermark.

corner.prompt: A single ornate top-left CORNER ornament for a fantasy MMORPG UI window frame: small glowing deep-red gemstone at the corner, sharp gothic angular shapes, two short straight beveled metal bars extending right and down from the corner (L shape). Square 1024x1024.

title.prompt: A wide horizontal TITLE PLAQUE banner for the top of a game window: a long dark smoky-metal plate with bronze-gold beveled border, flanked symmetrically on left and right by spread gothic metal angel/dragon wings, a small red gem on top center. The center of the plate is plain dark and empty (space for a title). Perfectly left-right symmetric. Wide aspect ratio about 3:1.

divider.prompt: A single long thin horizontal ornamental DIVIDER line: thin bronze-gold metal bar that fades out toward both ends, with a small gothic filigree ornament and a tiny red gem in the exact center. Perfectly symmetric. Extremely wide aspect ratio about 8:1.

background.prompt: A seamless tileable square TEXTURE for a game window background: very dark (almost black) blue-grey weathered stone/leather surface with subtle faint engraved gothic filigree pattern, low contrast, dark enough for light text on top.

button.prompt: A single wide horizontal BUTTON plate for a game menu: a long rectangular dark gunmetal/stone panel with a thin bronze-gold beveled rim, slightly pointed angular end caps on left and right with a tiny red gem in each cap. Flat, even, unlit center so text can be drawn on it. Perfectly symmetric. Very wide aspect ratio about 6:1, filling the canvas width.

button_hover.prompt: A single wide horizontal BUTTON plate for a game menu in its HIGHLIGHTED/hover state: a long rectangular dark warm-bronze panel with a bright glowing gold beveled rim and a soft golden inner glow along the edges, slightly pointed angular end caps on left and right with a tiny glowing red gem in each cap. Center even and readable for text. Perfectly symmetric. Very wide aspect ratio about 6:1, filling the canvas width.

toggles.prompt: Exactly 2 separate horizontal TOGGLE SWITCH controls side by side with a clear empty gap between them, same size and shape: LEFT one is OFF - a rounded-rectangle dark recessed bronze-rimmed track with a dull dark metal round knob on the LEFT end; RIGHT one is ON - the same track filled with warm glowing gold/amber light and a bright gold knob with a small red gem on the RIGHT end. Each switch about 2:1 aspect.

controls.prompt: Exactly 3 separate small game UI parts in one horizontal row with wide empty gaps between them: 1) a small diamond-shaped slider KNOB made of gold metal with a glowing red gem center, 2) an ornate gold left-pointing ARROW button (triangular arrowhead, bronze bevel), 3) a small round gold CLOSE button with an X engraved in it (the X is a shape, not a letter).
